subject: Ownership lanes & procurement gates — draft MAP
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Patel <alex.patel@novamedhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ownership lanes & procurement gates — draft MAP

Alex — thanks for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed mutual action plan (attached) so we have alignment on owners and gated milestones. Key takeaways from the call: 

- Economic buyer: Jordan Patel (VP, Partnerships) will sign off on commercial terms and final SLA.
- Procurement lead: procurement@novamedhealth.com (procurement team) will require SOC2 evidence, data residency confirmation, and a standard security questionnaire.
- Legal: expects a 2-week internal review window; redlines to be limited to data handling, indemnity, and IP clauses.
- Success criteria: 1) <10% latency regression vs. current baseline, 2) monthly cost/unit budget target <= $0.015/token (projected after batching/quantization).

Next steps I captured (owner in parentheses):
1) Send draft MAP and timeline (Mina) — attached: Novamed_MAP_draft_v1.pdf
2) Procurement to list required evidence + timeline (Procurement) — ask by EOD Thu
3) Redwood to prepare SOC2 artifact bundle and short runbook for on-prem data flow (Rishi) — deliver 3 business days
4) Joint technical POC scope confirmation (Priyom + Novamed Eng) — schedule next week

Can you confirm the owners above and whether Jordan prefers a standalone pricing appendix or the pricing section inline with the SOW? If you prefer a shared doc, we can lock a Google folder and iterate.

Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0119
[Attachment: Novamed_MAP_draft_v1.pdf]

From: Alex Patel <alex.patel@novamedhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novamedhealth.com>, Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@novamedhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ownership lanes & procurement gates — draft MAP

Mina — thanks for the summary and the MAP. A few clarifications from procurement and Jordan: 

- Confirmed owners: Jordan will be the economic buyer (final sign-off) and I (Alex) will shepherd technical stakeholders. Procurement wants a single evidence bundle for SOC2 + encryption config. They also asked whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (CMK) in our Private offering.
- Timeline constraint: Procurement has a vendor window the week of July 12 — they want all artifacts submitted by Friday July 9 to hit their review cycle.
- Decision criteria: vendor must provide SLA for 99.9% inference availability, a rollback plan, and a clear pricing model for burst vs. committed usage.

Procurement (copied) — can you reply with a short checklist of required docs and preferred formats (PDF, ZIP for logs, link to compliance portal)?

Jordan — for pricing, we'd prefer a pricing appendix. That keeps the SOW cleaner.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alex

On Thu, Jul 01, 2027 at 09:12 Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the time earlier....

From: Procurement Team <procurement@novamedhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Alex Patel <alex.patel@novamedhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@novamedhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ownership lanes & procurement gates — draft MAP

Hi Mina / Alex — procurement checklist below. Please provide the listed items by COB Friday July 9 so we can include Redwood in the July 12 vendor window. Prefer PDF or ZIP.

Required items:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) + SOC2 summary (PDF)
- Encryption and key management overview (PDF) — indicate if CMK supported and KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault)
- Data residency and transfer controls (short runbook PDF)
- Contact for security incident response and SLAs (email + phone)
- Sample contract clause language for data retention and deletion (docx/pdf)

Optional (accelerates review):
- Short demo recording of the Private deployment flow (link)
- Pricing appendix (spreadsheet) for committed vs burst pricing

Thanks — Procurement Team
Procurement | Novamed Health
[Attachment: procurement_checklist_v1.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@novamedhealth.com>, Alex Patel <alex.patel@novamedhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Ownership lanes & procurement gates — draft MAP

Thanks — procurement. We're on it. Short update and commitments: 

- Rishi will assemble the SOC2 bundle + encryption/KMS compatibility note and deliver by Tue Jul 6 COB. (Rishi: see attached SOC2 evidence summary.)
- Priyom will draft a 1-page runbook for data residency and deletion flows (deliver Tue Jul 6).
- Mina will publish a pricing appendix (pricing-breakdown_v2.xlsx) and place it in the shared HubSpot/Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cnovamed-map
- We will mark the mutual action plan with gating dates tied to procurement deliverables so Jordan can see how procurement timing maps to signature.

Attachment list: Novamed_MAP_draft_v1.pdf, SOC2_evidence_summary.zip, pricing-breakdown_v2.xlsx

If procurement confirms the preferred format (PDF/ZIP) we're aligned to hit July 9.

Talk soon —
Mina
